reviews.title: Fast and great for large game libraries
reviews.comment:
I picked up the Crucial P310 4TB to use as a dedicated game drive and it has been a solid upgrade. Load times are quick, installs finish fast, and there is plenty of room for a large library without juggling space. 

The drive runs cool in my system and has been completely stable. If you need a big NVMe drive for gaming or general storage, this one has been reliable and performs well.
